title: Software Engineer with an Impactful Vision
subtitle: Building digital experiences that matter
description: I'm a software engineer who combines a passion for technology with a strong focus on functionality and user experience. Throughout my career, I've designed and developed complete web applications—from frontend to backend—using modern technologies (such as React, Node/ASP.NET, and relational and non-relational databases). I'm driven by turning ideas into tangible solutions. In every project, my goal is to scale with performance, maintain clean code, and ensure an intuitive UX.
